skill.name: mermaid-flowchart
skill.description: Create and refine Mermaid flowcharts using the official flowchart syntax reference, including nodes, edges, shapes, labels, links, styling, and layout options.
skill.summary: Build Mermaid flowcharts with syntax guidance for nodes, edges, shapes, links, styling, and layout.
skill.author: 46ki75

content.value_statement: Teams often need clear process diagrams but Mermaid syntax can be hard to remember. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to draft valid flowcharts with Mermaid syntax details.
actual_capabilities: Explains Mermaid flowchart node syntax, labels, shapes, and direction settings.
Shows how to connect nodes with arrows, open links, dotted links, and labeled edges.
Covers subgraphs, comments, classes, styling, and edge curve options.
Documents special icon and image node shapes for Mermaid flowcharts.
Includes guidance for interactive links, callbacks, and tooltip syntax.
Provides Mermaid examples for common flowchart structures and formatting choices.
limitations: It is a Markdown reference, not a renderer or diagram validator.
It does not install Mermaid or run Mermaid CLI commands.
Some examples depend on Mermaid version support in the target environment.
Interactive callbacks and external links need separate security review before production use.

use_cases.title: Document a Workflow
use_cases.description: Draft a Mermaid flowchart that shows steps, decisions, and outcomes for a business or engineering process.

use_cases.title: Map Application Logic
use_cases.description: Create a readable control-flow diagram for services, jobs, states, or branching behavior in a codebase.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Diagrams
use_cases.description: Refine Mermaid syntax, labels, shapes, and styling so an existing flowchart is clearer and easier to maintain.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Flowchart
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple process diagram.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Mermaid flowchart for this process: [describe the steps]. Use clear node labels and a top-to-bottom layout.

prompt_templates.title: Add Decisions and Labels
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with branches and edge labels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this workflow into a Mermaid flowchart with decision nodes and labeled arrows: [workflow details]. Keep labels short.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor an Existing Diagram
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve readability and syntax of current Mermaid content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Mermaid flowchart and improve its structure, labels, direction, and styling without changing the meaning: [paste diagram].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Styled Technical Diagram
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using subgraphs, classes, and layout choices.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production-ready Mermaid flowchart for [system or process]. Use subgraphs, consistent shapes, class styling, and notes about Mermaid version requirements.

output_examples.input: A request to show a customer support triage process.
output_examples.output: A concise Mermaid flowchart description with start, intake, severity decision, escalation, resolution, and closure steps.

output_examples.input: A rough Mermaid diagram with confusing labels and repeated nodes.
output_examples.output: A revised diagram plan with clearer node names, fewer duplicate branches, labeled decision paths, and consistent layout direction.

output_examples.input: A request to document a backend job pipeline.
output_examples.output: A structured flowchart outline that separates ingestion, validation, processing, failure handling, and reporting into readable sections.

best_practices: Use short node labels and explain complex details outside the diagram.
Choose one main flow direction and keep branch labels consistent.
Check Mermaid version support before using newer shapes, icons, or renderer options.
anti_patterns: Do not place large paragraphs inside flowchart nodes.
Do not mix many shape meanings without a legend or clear convention.
Do not enable interactive callbacks for untrusted diagrams without security review.

faq.question: Does this skill render Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: No. It provides syntax guidance and examples for creating Mermaid flowcharts.

faq.question: Can it fix broken Mermaid syntax?
faq.answer: It can help identify likely syntax issues, but it does not run a Mermaid parser.

faq.question: Which diagram type does it cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on Mermaid flowcharts, including nodes, edges, subgraphs, styling, and layout.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a local Markdown reference and does not make network requests.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are interactive Mermaid links safe?
faq.answer: They can be useful, but callbacks and external links should be reviewed before use in production pages.
